dct_title_s: Palestine and Syria with the chief routes through Mesopotamia and Babylonia : handbook for travellers
dct_description_sm: by Karl Baedeker. With 20 maps, 52 plans, and a panorama of Jerusalem.
"Works on Palestine and Syria": p. xcviii-c.

"The first edition of the handbook appeared, in German, in 1875; its writer was Dr. Albert Socin...The present is the fourth English edition and is based on the sixth German edition...prepared by Dr. Immanuel Benzinger...The new section on Mesopotamia and Babylonia has been revised and supplemented by the Rev. John P. Peters." cf. Pref.
Copy held in The Leonard and Juliet Rothman Holy Land Map Collection is not shown; digital imagery provided is from another copy
